mentions.name: Lighthouse
mentions.description: An RSS reader built around an inbox zero workflow. It splits content into an Inbox for new items and a Library for bookmarked items, so users can quickly process new feed entries and take their time reading saved ones later.
mentions.problem: Traditional RSS readers show read and unread items in the same feed-organized list, making it hard to know what has already been seen and to manage items intended for later reading.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lighthouse (https://lighthouseapp.io/) - a different take on RSS readers, focusing on inbox zero
